name: Proper Training
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
body:
Drawbacks
Proper Training
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
Category Faction
Your time at the Grand Lodge of Absalom has served you well. Choose either Knowledge (geography) or Knowledge (history). You gain a +1 trait bonus on all checks for the chosen skill, and the chosen skill becomes a class skill for you.
